summary:
Published Workspace.Template0.19.0 and SDD2.2.0 composition must be authenticated after scaffolding: Foundation initializes the .fsgg lifecycle files, root guidance, work/readiness directories and automatic typed knowledge. There is no root sdd-directory contract. Complete product inventory derives from the authenticated selected package definition, every selected modifier and exact name/namespace substitutions; representative files and unhashed producedPaths cannot prove preservation. Preserve all product bytes/modes except demonstrated structural tool-manifest union, exact SDD-prefix/product-segment/knowledge-block ignore composition, published .sh mode OR0111, and applicable product skill-manifest amendment. Large initial Git blobs use complete local content-addressed identity plus committed tree mode/object identity so bounded metadata proves complete bytes.

Programme/root accepted the complete two-row non-SVG published provider Delivery4773 on2026-10-21 in public owning comment6324485155, linked from the cited roadmap: explicit typed and genuinely omitted lifecycle both initialized typed knowledge and passed their complete capture/retrieval/history/export/restore/Git recovery and exact10MiB/+1 checker promise. This acceptance covers only those non-SVG provider receivers. Original failures and historical Unknowns remain; PLAYER, other provider/Wizard routes, product/browser/WASM and retained upgrades keep their own acceptance. The legacy selected package has no product skill manifest; that observation does not apply to current PLAYER.

Current PLAYER includes its product manifest and owner payloads. Authenticate the complete schema-preserving existing-row union with applicable published driver/game/rendering/audio additions, supplier metadata, declared file sets, genuine compiled supplier bytes, seeded process skills and amended provenance. Published Contracts.Schemas.agentSkillRoots is exactly .claude and .agents. Derive emitted union/seeded expectations from that authenticated producer contract; keep every product-owned asset, including any .codex content, in the complete package inventory and initial Git proof. A product-owned agent directory does not imply a producer-emitted union manifest.

PLAYER runtime01 stopped after three successful scaffold commands because the adapter demanded an unshipped .codex skill manifest. The original fixture repeated the same three-root assumption, so green controls failed to authenticate this supplier contract. No initial commit or knowledge probes ran and no PLAYER receiver was accepted. The source repair authenticates complete published Schemas source and genuine Contracts assembly, derives the roots from the published declaration, and adds independent root-contract and product-Codex preservation controls. A source repair grants no replay or runtime acceptance.

COMPLETE bundle (Delivery4798): the published Workspace.Template COMPLETE bundle is qualified through SDD2.2.0 by a separate sealed adapter that supplies bundle=complete through the immutable provider descriptor and omits svgFoundation; explicit typed and genuinely omitted lifecycle both initialize typed knowledge automatically. The compiled supplier union is bundle-dependent: five more skills (fs-gg-rules, fs-gg-layout, fs-gg-styling, fs-gg-ui-widgets, fs-gg-svg-assets) are gated on bundle containing complete and must be derived from the pinned compiled Commands manifests, not reused from PLAYER. The first actual attempt against Workspace.Template0.19.0 on 2026-10-22 failed on the first row at complete-owner-bytes:SvgFoundation/Examples/Wasm/guest/policy.c: the template engine applied C-style conditional processing to the C source and removed its three POLICY_* blocks (1308 to 1130 bytes), a supplier defect (FS.GG.Templates#729), not an adapter assumption; that original failure stays retained and is not cleared retroactively. Workspace.Template0.19.1 (Templates PR #730, literal **/*.c and **/*.h operations) was published; the adapter was re-pinned to its nuget.org package (identical to the GitHub Release asset over every non-signature entry), template.json and the0.19.1 provider descriptor, and the inventory re-derived from the package is 175 applicable owner files, 12 exclusions and 57 COMPLETE-only files (earlier171/12/53; the delta is the four added FourD local-save-replay files). A fresh root-admitted original two-row runtime on 2026-10-22 (SDD2.2.0, both rows one original attempt, no retry, 783 commands, 20.5 s, peak tree RSS about 0.45 GiB) passed both rows: byte-exact owner files including policy.c (1308 bytes), supplier union and provenance, parentless initial Git tree, four synthetic findings with get/search/relations/evidence/history/idempotence, expected stale/prohibited-source/no-clobber refusals, private exclusion, ALL-shared export/restore, Git bundle recovery and exact10485760 pass with +1 refusal. An independent runtime review returned ACCEPT-WITH-NITS. Two earlier admission attempts were refused before any child or clock because another owner briefly held a coordination lock; they are not runtime failures. This accepts only the COMPLETE provider rows with explicit typed lifecycle and genuinely omitted lifecycle; it does not claim product/browser/WASM execution, Wizard or literal-safe acceptance, retained upgrades, other parent4642 routes, or any change to PLAYER original failure and accepted runtime02. Private evidence stays in operator custody.
